package.name: parallax
package.summary: Go/Rust-semantic concurrency primitive for PHP — WaitGroup + spawn with isolated per-worker runtimes and snapshot-copy captures. PECL slug is `parallax`; the GitHub repo, Debian/Ubuntu package, Alpine package, and install script are all named `php-parallax` (same convention as the `redis` PECL extension shipping as `php-redis` on Debian).
package.description:
php-parallax adds OS-thread parallelism to PHP with Go `go func` and Rust `move` semantics: every spawned task runs in its own ZTS thread with a fresh PHP request lifecycle, captures are deep-copied at spawn time, and per-slot error semantics guarantee that one panicking worker never affects its siblings.
Surface in v0.1.0 is intentionally minimal — WaitGroup, ParallaxResult, ParallaxWorkerError, CaptureError, SpawnError. Named functions and static methods are supported as callables; closure capture is the v0.2.0 milestone.
package.notes:
v0.2.1 — bug-fix and release-infrastructure pass.
- bridge: stdClass dynamic properties are now preserved across the thread boundary. The capture code used to walk only the declared properties_info table, silently dropping every dynamic field on stdClass and similar dynamic objects. - release.yml: Docker tag now lowercases the registry owner and reads the resolved version from a properly declared `needs` dependency. - PECL package name corrected to `parallax` (the channel validator rejects '-' in package names and requires name == providesextension). Project / Debian / Alpine name stays php-parallax. - dev: PHPUnit harness with 33 tests and 2087 assertions covering every callable form, every capture rejection, error isolation, snapshot semantics, real parallelism, large-payload round-trips. - dev: php-cs-fixer and PHPStan level 8 jobs added to CI. - dist: Alpine apk repository workflow publishes signed packages to gh-pages on tag push.
